intro.title: Advertising products & signage guides
intro.description: Learn how Supreme Advertising designs, prints, and installs signage across Sri Lanka — from vehicle wraps and lightboxes to exhibition stalls and billboards.

posts.title: Vehicle Branding: Turn Your Fleet Into Moving Billboards
posts.excerpt: Custom wraps and fleet graphics that keep your brand visible on every road, without blowing the marketing budget.
posts.imageAlt: Commercial vehicle branding by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Vehicle branding is one of the most cost-effective ways to advertise in Sri Lanka. Your vans, lorries, and cars travel where your customers live and work — so every trip becomes a chance to show your logo, offer, and contact details.

At Supreme Advertising in Ragama, we design and apply full wraps, partial panels, and fleet-consistent graphics using durable print and professional installation. Because the vehicles are always in motion, you reach audiences you cannot buy with a single static sign.
Whether you run one delivery van or a nationwide fleet, we align colours, typography, and layout with your brand guidelines so every vehicle looks like it belongs to the same company.
bullets: High-resolution print and lamination for outdoor use
Design support from concept to installation

posts.title: Dealer Boards: High-Impact Signage for Storefronts & Roadside
posts.excerpt: Bold dealer boards that capture drive-by traffic day and night — ideal when you need visibility without a full shopfront.
posts.imageAlt: Outdoor dealer board signage by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Dealer boards are built for businesses that need strong presence at the curb — tyre shops, distributors, showrooms, and service brands that rely on passing traffic.

If you do not have a traditional storefront, or you want to reinforce your main sign after dark, a well-lit or high-contrast dealer board puts your name and offer where drivers and pedestrians notice it first.
We produce boards in sizes and finishes suited to Sri Lankan weather and your mounting location, with graphics designed for quick reading at a distance.

posts.title: Interior Branding: Signs That Guide and Impress Indoors
posts.excerpt: Wall graphics, reception branding, and wayfinding that shape how visitors feel inside your space.
posts.imageAlt: Interior branding and wall graphics by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Once customers step inside, interior branding controls first impressions, navigation, and trust. Reception logos, feature walls, directional signs, and department labels all work together.
Supreme creates indoor sign solutions matched to your brand — from vinyl wall applications and acrylic panels to cut lettering and printed displays for offices, retail, healthcare, and hospitality.
Thoughtful interior signage reduces confusion, reinforces professionalism, and keeps your visual identity consistent from the street to the service desk.
bullets: Materials selected for indoor durability and finish

posts.title: Display Units: Point-of-Sale Branding That Sells
posts.excerpt: Custom racks, counters, and POS displays that organize products and put your brand at the decision point.
posts.imageAlt: Custom retail display units by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Display units turn shelves and counters into branded sales tools. Headers, shelf strips, side panels, and base wraps keep products tidy while shouting your identity where purchases happen.
We build compact pharmacy counters, tyre and battery racks, water-jug stands, hand-washing stations, and trade-show-ready fixtures — fabricated to your dimensions with durable print and laminate.
From a single countertop unit to a full showroom layout, Supreme handles design, production, and branding so your products stay visible, accessible, and on-message.
bullets: Custom sizes for retail, warehouse, and events

posts.title: 3D Signage: Dimensional Letters That Define Your Building
posts.excerpt: Outdoor dimensional lettering and monument signs with optional LED illumination for day-and-night identification.
posts.imageAlt: 3D outdoor signage and dimensional letters by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Three-dimensional signage is the clearest way to mark your business on a facade or monument structure. Raised letters and logos cast shadows, catch light, and read from farther away than flat prints alone.
Supreme produces custom dimensional letters in metal, high-density foam, and durable plastics — with LED, halo, and backlit options so your name stays readable after sunset.
We help you choose size, depth, finish, and mounting for Sri Lankan conditions, whether the sign faces a main road or sits on a pylon at your entrance.
bullets: Installation planning for visibility and longevity

posts.title: Exhibition Stalls: Trade Show Booths That Stop Traffic
posts.excerpt: Custom booths with backlit headers, printed wraps, and 3D logos built to dominate the show floor.
posts.imageAlt: Custom exhibition stall by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Trade shows and exhibitions are short windows to make a big impression. Your stall must communicate brand, products, and credibility in seconds as visitors walk the aisle.
Supreme designs and builds exhibition stalls with backlit headers, illuminated panels, counters, shelving, and fully printed booth wraps — plus 3D logos for extra depth.
From compact corners to large convention footprints, we manage design, production, and on-site setup so your team can focus on conversations, not carpentry.

posts.title: Billboards: Large-Format Vinyl Faces Built to Last
posts.excerpt: High-resolution printed billboard faces on flexible vinyl — vivid colour for structures you own or rent.
posts.imageAlt: Billboard vinyl printing by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Billboards still deliver mass reach along highways and urban corridors. Supreme digitally prints custom billboard faces in full four-colour process on 12–13 oz flexible white vinyl at up to 600 dpi so colours pop at scale.

Finishing options include bleed and pole pockets for wrapping around structures. We use solvent UV-resistant inks to slow sun fading; expect roughly two to three years of life before noticeable fade, depending on exposure.
Production typically runs one to two weeks after artwork approval. We print and deliver faces for installation on your structure — we do not broker billboard rental locations.
bullets: 600 dpi digital print on 12–13 oz vinyl
Building wraps and stadium-scale banners available

posts.title: Lightboxes: Illuminated Signs That Work Around the Clock
posts.excerpt: Swappable illuminated faces for facades, pylons, and monuments — 24-hour branding without replacing the whole unit.
posts.imageAlt: Illuminated lightbox signage by Supreme Advertising
paragraphs: Lightboxes make your business easier to find at night and add polish to directory, monument, and dimensional signage. Even lighting across the face keeps logos and offers readable after dark.
Because the graphic is a replaceable panel, you can refresh campaigns without buying an entirely new sign — a practical choice for retail, restaurants, property managers, and public-facing offices.
Supreme supplies outdoor lightbox faces and complete solutions that mount to existing pylons, monument signs, or building facades across Sri Lanka.
bullets: Even illumination for logos and offers
Suited to retail, F&B, property, and institutional sites
